notes: The model explains a finding and its fix in at most two sentences ({explanation, fix}). Graded later by LLM graders against the rubric (required_facts, forbidden_claims); score.py only reports schema validity, the sentence cap and forbidden_patterns hits as automatic flags. forbidden_patterns match only command names that cannot appear in a correct answer; a word a correct answer may use in plain English or in a negation (terminate, isNil) is left to forbidden_claims. Codes marked 'spike-local label' have no id in the docs yet.

items.message: Designer-authored End #1 trigger 'trg_win' in a campaign-managed mission.
items.context: Mission m03_bridge is managed by the campaign: outcome 'bridge_blown' uses the END1 socket and 'retreat' uses END2; the compiler places one END trigger per outcome that reads an outcome flag. Designer trigger trg_win: Type End #1, Activation None, Condition: !alive bridgeTruck.
items.card: C13 (error): in a campaign-managed mission the compiler owns the END/LOOSE triggers, one per outcome socket, and a mission ends by setting the outcome flag its trigger reads. The engine ends with ending n only when EVERY End #n trigger is active at the same moment, so an extra designer End #1 trigger turns 'bridge blown' into 'bridge blown AND truck destroyed' and breaks routing. Fix: delete trg_win and attach its condition to an outcome action (set outcome 'bridge_blown') instead.

required_facts: All End #1 triggers must be active together (AND), so the extra trigger changes when the managed ending fires
Fix: remove the designer END trigger and set the campaign outcome (outcome flag) from its condition
forbidden_claims: same-number End triggers act as OR

items.message: Title-layer BLACK OUT before an END in sequence 'seq_outro_win'.
items.context: Sequence seq_outro_win runs near the end of the Mission section: line 12 is titleText ["", "BLACK OUT", 2]; line 13 sets win_done = true; an End #1 trigger has Condition win_done.
items.card: DR13: fades and cards near an ending belong on the cut layer. A title-layer effect that is still alive (titleText, trigger Effects titles, say subtitles and chat lines share that layer) blocks the mission end, and a title-layer BLACK OUT holds indefinitely, so the End #1 trigger never ends the mission; cut-layer effects (cutText, cutRsc) do not block it. Fix: use cutText ["", "BLACK OUT", 2] for the fade.

required_facts: A title-layer effect that is still showing blocks the mission end (a title-layer BLACK OUT never clears, so the mission never ends)
Fix: use cutText (the cut layer) instead of titleText for the fade
forbidden_claims: titleText and cutText behave the same
an invented fade command or BIS function

items.message: Unsupported audio format: sound\radio_intro.mp3 cannot be played by the engine.
items.context: CfgSounds class radio_intro points to sound\radio_intro.mp3 (stereo, 44.1 kHz). Target profile: CWR 3.05.
items.card: AU08: the engine loads only .ogg (Vorbis), .wav (RIFF PCM) and WSS, chosen by the file extension; MP3, Opus and FLAC are read as WSS and fail. Files never have more than two channels. Fix: transcode to Vorbis .ogg (the import pipeline does this) and point the class at the new file. Mono is better for positional use.

required_facts: MP3 is not a format the engine plays (only OGG Vorbis, PCM WAV or WSS)
Fix: convert the file to .ogg (or PCM .wav) and update the class's file path
forbidden_claims: renaming the extension makes MP3 play
an addon or plugin makes MP3 play

items.message: setRain while overcast is below about 0.673 (trigger trg_rain).
items.context: Intel: overcast 0.3 at start, forecast 0.3. Trigger trg_rain fires at 20 minutes with On Activation: 60 setRain 0.3.
items.card: AL02: the engine forces rain to 0 while overcast is below about 0.673, so this setRain has no visible effect; above that, rain can reach at most 1.5 x overcast - 1 (never more than 0.5). Only one gradual weather change runs at a time. Fix: ramp overcast up first (for example 600 setOvercast 0.9, which allows rain up to 0.35), wait for the ramp to finish, then setRain.

required_facts: Rain stays at 0 while overcast is below about 0.67, so the setRain does nothing
Fix: raise overcast first (for example with setOvercast), then set rain

items.message: Trigger 'trg_village' can never fire: Activation None with Condition 'this'.
items.context: trg_village: Activation None, Present, Once, Condition: this, Type End #1, placed over the village of Pevna.
items.card: Standing Orders, trigger activation: a new trigger starts with Activation None. With None no area test runs, so `this` is false and the default Condition `this` never fires. Fix: set Activation to the side whose presence matters (for 'village cleared': East, Not present), or write a custom Condition that does not rely on `this`.

required_facts: With Activation None no area test runs, so `this` stays false and the trigger never fires
Fix: choose an activation side and presence, or write a custom condition

items.message: Trigger 'trg_alarm_react' reads global 'alarm', which nothing assigns before the first read.
items.context: trg_alarm_react: Activation None, Condition: alarm, On Activation: [] exec "ofpe\qrf.sqs". Trigger trg_spotted (West, Detected by East) sets alarm = true. init.sqs does not mention alarm.
items.card: Lint global-read-before-init: an unset global reads as nil. A trigger condition must be a Boolean, and a nil condition silently counts as false, so it works only by luck and any other read (for example !alarm) is nil too. isNil is not in this engine. Fix: initialise it in init.sqs: alarm = false.

required_facts: Until assigned, alarm is undefined (nil); a nil condition evaluates as false
Fix: initialise alarm = false in init.sqs
forbidden_claims: publicVariable is required in single player

sources: docs/research/20-upstream-test-inventory.md (an undefined global is nil; a nil Bool reads as false)

items.message: Trigger 'trg_alarm' uses Detected by East, but the mission file has no East group.
items.context: Every East unit is created by script 2 minutes after start. trg_alarm: West, Detected by East, Once, over the depot. Target profile: CWR 3.05, single player.
items.card: Standing Orders, Detected by: the detecting side must exist. In single player a side's AI centre is created only if the mission file has at least one group of that side; without it the trigger stops before its Condition and never fires. Fix: place one East unit in the editor (even at 0% probability of presence), or on CWR/CE run createCenter east at start.

required_facts: East has no AI centre because no East group is in the mission file, so the trigger never fires
Fix: place one East unit (0% presence is fine), or createCenter east on CWR/CE
forbidden_claims: Detected by fires on true positions
an invented command to register a side

items.message: Group 'Alpha Black' has 15 crew seats; the cap is 12.
items.context: East group Alpha Black: 5 x BMP, each with driver, gunner and commander seats.
items.card: Group cap: 12 crew seats per group, compiled into the engine. Each unit adds one per driver, gunner and commander seat its type has; a soldier counts 1. Five three-seat vehicles make 15. The original editor refuses the group with an error and hides Preview until it is fixed. Fix: split the vehicles into two groups (for example 3 + 2).

required_facts: The cap counts crew seats: 5 vehicles x 3 seats = 15, above 12
Fix: split into two groups (or use fewer vehicles)
forbidden_claims: the limit counts units rather than seats
a config or addon change raises the cap for this mission

items.message: Three consecutive Peak nodes on path A: m04 River Crossing, m05 Hill 214, m06 The Depot.
items.context: Campaign path A intensities: m01 Build, m02 Peak, m03 Relax, m04 Peak, m05 Peak, m06 Peak, m07 Relax, m08 Finale.
items.card: CF01 (warn): three or more consecutive Peak or Finale nodes on a path cause fatigue; the intensity curve should be a sawtooth that rises within an act, dips, then peaks higher. Relax nodes are cutscenes, hubs, recon or scavenge missions. Fix: turn m05 into a Relax or Build node (for example a recon or resupply mission), or insert a breather between m04 and m06.

required_facts: Three peaks in a row give no valley, which tires the player
Fix: make a middle node Relax or Build, or insert a breather mission
forbidden_claims: the engine refuses to run the campaign

items.message: exitWith in an .sqs script does not end the script (ofpe\patrol.sqs, line 7).
items.context: ofpe\patrol.sqs line 7: if (!alive leader1) exitWith {hint "done"}. Lines 8-20 keep moving the group. Target: CWR 3.05.
items.card: In an .sqs script, if (...) exitWith {...} leaves only the current statement; the script continues on the next line. To end an SQS script use the conditional line ? <condition> : exit (for example ? !alive leader1 : exit). The ? line is split at the first ':'.

required_facts: exitWith only leaves the current statement; the script goes on with line 8
Fix: use the SQS line ? !alive leader1 : exit
